headline: Quiet on bugs: the no-model guard is merged and holding (0 model-less rows since 08:20 ET 11-18), but the NY high lock has come in under for three warm days in a row (11-18 lost 62-63 at 0.84, actual 64) and marked the day over at 12:55 while the park was still climbing.

findings.title: NY high: three warm lock misses in a row
findings.evidence: kalshi_ny.json err 11-16..11-18: -1.19, -0.53, -1.55 (11-14 -1.18); 11-18 lock 62-63 p 0.843, actual 64 (provisional, Kalshi 64-65 last 0.99); against-64-65 bet lost, edge court 23 +0.298 -> 24 +0.235; live bias -0.45 on 76

findings.title: Binding call with the day still climbing (ny_high 11-18)
findings.evidence: trail ny_high_2026-11-18: over=true 12:55-13:50 at hmax 62.06, sd 0.61, 62-63 p 0.75; 13:55 hmax 63.70, settled 64; 130 rows p>0.6 on the losing bracket; third binding day that kept climbing (11-11, 11-14, 11-18); mkt_pull_bind acts before 13:00 only

findings.title: Stale cold-court why: a change that is not applied
findings.evidence: tuned.json ny_high why and kalshi_report.json settings say 'COLD COURT: mkt_pull_cold 0.65 -> 1.0'; active mkt_pull_cold null, cold_court.applied false (76c3d44); tonight's refit should rewrite it

findings.evidence: kalshi-nightly.yml cron 08:20Z; scheduled runs started 11-16 18:39Z, 11-17 17:40Z, 11-18 17:19Z (all success); the 11-19 run has not started at 10:05Z

findings.evidence: ny_high 11-18: 17 models:null rows, all 01:15-08:20 ET (before 71efd78 / 360ec81); 0 since, 0 on 11-19; NY low 11-17 err 0.00 hit, 11-18 45-46 likely hit; kalshi-nyc.yml 100/100 ok
